items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I had a kind of a big role in Robichaud's, John Robichaud's band.

ctx.x: Well, I asked him who he played with right before he played with Jack.

He said, who you played with before you played with Jack? Let's see. What's that with Jack? I had a kind of a big role in Robichaud's, John Robichaud's band. So that means- And then, you know, John Robichaud had a Spanish band, good, you know. And he used to play for all the rich white people. And now and then he would play for the college when they had a tag. And so, he kind of went down during the length. So his drummer, I was playing with his drummer. There was four or five piece band, Walter Blunder. You got…
Big George Williams. Yeah. I hear him in the street with Big George.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I said, who else used to be with Robeshoe? ... He didn't have no piano player with him when I was with him.

ctx.x: the, uh, let's see, who else would be with Robeshoe?

I said, who else used to be with Robeshoe? I said, Tito, Tito, Tito, Big Gaskey, Walter Blunder, let me see, a woman used to play piano. I don't know. He didn't have no piano player with him when I was with him. No. I knew at the Lyric Theater when Robeshoe was playing there he had Kimball's wife on piano. Oh, yeah, yeah. Yeah, Kimball's wife. Yeah. Jeanette?
Is that who you're talking about? Yeah, yeah.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And he's got a brother. His brother is Wilde played. Played all classical music. Professor, you know.

ctx.x: So how about Sidney Correa? Sidney used to play soccer and...

Clowness. He was a musician. Look at him, too. We used to play together. We played together a long time. And he's got a brother. His brother is... Wilde played. Played all classical music. And he's got a brother. His brother is Wilde played. Played all classical music. Professor, you know. He's a cripple. One leg short and the other. And then Sidney got a neck to play a drum. I don't think of his name. Ask him what band was it that he and Sidney worked together in. He said, what band was it that you and Sidney…
